public.text: The requirement to avoid unmanaged bilateral connections is appropriate, but managed direct connections can be practical and conformant. The distinction between managed and unmanaged point-to-point exchange needs definition.
public.suggestedRevision: Define managed direct exchange as using registered endpoints, shared standards, documented ownership, conformance testing, monitoring, security controls, lifecycle management, and maintained mappings.
